timeline_initial_exclusion.json.reason: Duplicate periods key while writing protocol; exited before stack or measurement started

timeline_decode_exclusion.json.reason: Parser initially rejected signed -1 TID on exiting tasks; load terminated before completion validation. Recovered diagnostic retained but excluded. Raw PEBS can also carry TID=-1; final parser resolves only exact target CPU scheduling intervals and reports these separately.

timeline_static_tids_exclusion.json.reason: MovieId creates and exits per-request threads during the capture; static scheduler filter misses their intervals. Whole capture excluded before timeline analysis.
